optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst, Subscription Analytics
professionalSummary: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst with six years of experience in revenue operations, including three years leading the board revenue pack and signing it off before finance director review. Proven ability to supervise analysts, reconcile revenue packs to billing systems, and document pack boundaries and open items. Holds a BSc in Economics (2018).
experienceHighlights: Led the board revenue pack for three years, signing off each monthly pack prior to finance director review.
Supervised the analyst assembling the pack, reviewing assembly checklists and variance commentary.
Reconciled the revenue pack to the billing system monthly under a documented procedure, maintaining workbooks and exception logs.
Authored pack boundary notes and open items lists, updating them after billing system changes.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Signed-off board revenue pack with boundary note and open items list.
Monthly reconciliation workbook with exception log.
Assembly checklist, all stored in finance shared drive as verification trail.
